**Observation Log:**

- [EVENT] User is planning to participate in another auto racking event soon.
- [EVENT] User completed 10 laps at the Speed Demon Racing Track with an average speed of 85mph during the Turbocharged Tuesdays event on 2023/03/15.
- [ASSISTANT] Assistant provided tips on suspension upgrades to improve car handling, including stiffer springs, adjustable coilovers, sway bars, bushings and mounts, camber and toe adjustments, and lightweight wheels and tires.
- [ASSISTANT] Assistant suggested general tips to improve lap times, including checking tire pressure and temperature, upgrading brake pads and fluid, ensuring proper seat and safety equipment, focusing on driver training and feedback, and familiarizing with the track layout.
- [EVENT] User got a discount on a set of new brake pads during the Winter Tune-Up event at the Speed Shop earlier this year but hasn't installed them yet.
- [ASSISTANT] Assistant advised that upgrading brake fluid is worth considering when installing new brake pads, especially for track use.
- [ASSISTANT] Assistant recommended looking for high-performance brake fluid with a DOT 4 or DOT 5.1 rating, high wet boiling point, low viscosity, and corrosion inhibitors.
- [EVENT] User has been thinking about their car's engine performance and noticed a slight misfire during their daily commute.
- [CHANGE] User replaced the spark plugs with new ones from NGK, which made the engine feel much smoother and responsive.
- [ASSISTANT] Assistant provided tips to optimize engine performance for the next auto racking event, including checking the air filter and intake, using high-octane fuel, verifying spark plug gapping and indexing, checking the ignition system, tuning the fuel injection, ensuring proper engine oil and cooling, inspecting intake and exhaust systems, performing compression and leak-down tests, checking the drivetrain and transmission, and practicing smooth driving techniques.
- [EVENT] User is considering getting a dyno test done to see their engine's horsepower and torque.
- [EVENT] User had a dyno test done at the "Tune-Up Saturday" event at the Performance Garage, which showed their car was producing 240 horsepower.
- [ASSISTANT] Assistant advised on preparing the car for the dyno test, including ensuring the car is in good condition, choosing the right dyno, preparing the car properly, getting multiple runs, and interpreting the results correctly.
